summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only feature-addition testing (Building Mutuality marketing site). Verified nav dropdowns (desktop hover + mobile expandable), 4 dedicated resource category pages, sticky connect button, interview embeds on Home & About, About page enrichment, and full route regression. All requested features work correctly. No blocking issues found.

features_verified.desktop_nav_dropdowns: PASS - Services dropdown reveals 4 sublinks (programmes, executive-coaching, culture-audits, hi-accreditation); Resources dropdown reveals 4 sublinks (white-whale-research, white-papers, collaborations, news). Clicking navigates correctly. data-testid nav-dropdown-Services / nav-dropdown-Resources / nav-sublink-<href> all present.
features_verified.mobile_nav_dropdowns: PASS - mobile-menu-toggle opens menu, chevron on Services/Resources expands sublinks, tapping sublink navigates and menu closes on pathname change (verified for /resources/news).
features_verified.resource_category_pages: PASS - /resources/white-whale-research (5 items), /resources/white-papers (4), /resources/collaborations (4, all with 'Coming Soon' tag), /resources/news (4). PageHero, resource-item testids, cta-band and ExploreNext all render. Invalid slug /resources/nonsense correctly redirects to /resources.
features_verified.resources_hub: PASS - all 4 resource-category-<slug> cards present linking to dedicated pages.
features_verified.sticky_connect: PASS - hidden initially, appears after scrollY > 500 on Home with href=/contact, not rendered on /contact.
features_verified.interviews_section: PASS - present on / and /about with 3 embeds. interview-video-0 iframe src contains linkedin.com/embed, interview-video-1 iframe src is https://www.youtube.com/embed/W5EjWImS9Vc, interview-video-2 is <video> with source /videos/times-square.mp4.
features_verified.about_enrichment: PASS - about-read-more toggle works, all 8 credential keywords found (AGSM, Financial Times, CXO 2.0, Times Square, Harvard, Golden Key, MeetMagic, 1.7M), interviews section renders, Daniane Fernandes section renders.
features_verified.regression_routes: PASS - all 15 routes load without console errors: /, /who-we-help, /fifth-revolution, /services, /services/programmes, /services/executive-coaching, /services/culture-audits, /services/hi-accreditation, /about, /book, /ethos, /resources, /speaking, /contact, /privacy-policy.
features_verified.mobile_overflow: PASS - no horizontal overflow at 390px width on /, /contact, /resources/white-papers (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Home page emits two VIDEOJS console errors ('CODE:4 MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED') likely from an existing hero/video component unrelated to this iteration. Not a regression (present prior). Consider verifying the media source or removing video.js if unused.

Minor: /about triggers networkidle timeout in Playwright because the LinkedIn/YouTube iframes never fully idle in the sandbox — expected per instructions; using domcontentloaded works fine. No user-facing impact.

Sublinks in the mobile menu do not have data-testid attributes (only desktop nav-sublink-<href> testids exist). If the mobile sublink flow needs automated coverage in future iterations, add data-testid="mobile-nav-sublink-<href>" to the mobile menu Link elements in Navigation.tsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 features (nav dropdowns, dedicated resource pages, sticky connect, interviews, About enrichment) fully pass. Use ?nolenis=1 to bypass Lenis smooth scroll for scroll-triggered assertions. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' instead of 'networkidle' for pages containing LinkedIn/YouTube iframes (Home, About) since external embeds may be blocked by sandbox and prevent networkidle. Mobile menu sublinks lack their own data-testids — locate via a[href=...] within [data-testid=mobile-menu].
